purpose: Complete the final XGTC ACTP transition interrupt mask so O6 resynchronization can restore the OMCI carrier.
root_cause: Both stock and native ACTP setup initially program 0x07a3dfff at PON+0x4d2c. Stock final interrupt initialization overwrites it with 0x0fffffff; native activation omitted that step. The initial mask excludes transition bit27. Following O5 loss, native IRQ turns OMCI carrier off; a lone O6 resynchronization event is then masked, leaving carrier off until another event causes a status refresh.
fix: Write 0x0fffffff to PON+0x4d2c during final activation IRQ setup, before enabling parent ACTP and global IRQs. Preserve the earlier ACTP-stage mask and existing state/key/path handling.

verification.stock_scope: Executes actual original aal_xgpon_intr_init and aal_xgpon_intr_clr for modes4/5 with initial ACTP mask seeded. Register writes are observed; tasklet/queue allocation, locks and logging are modeled. No physical IRQ delivery.
verification.before_result: XGPON mode4: configured mask07a3dfff, O6 resync carrier0; expected carrier assertion fails. First failing mode aborts execution.
verification.after_result: XGPON mode4 and XGSPON mode5: configured mask0fffffff, O6 resync carrier1; existing O6/assignment/coalesced identity/timeout scenarios also pass under ASan and UBSan.
verification.native_scope: Runs extracted production ACTP parameter setup, activation and IRQ functions. New regression dispatches transitions only when programmed child/parent/global masks permit. MMIO, carrier, locks, timing, SerDes restart, key calls and work scheduling are modeled.
verification.fixture_repair: Initial fixture compilation required errno.h after extracting the activation function; that compile error was corrected before obtaining the failing functional baseline. Original diagnostic retained in fixture-compile-error.log.

additional_research.old_key_retirement: Original __xgpon_key_valid_set is a no-op and TK5 timeout does not delete hardware keys. No evidence justifies adding speculative old-key retirement.
additional_research.queue_capacity: Original PUC/VOQ and OMCI allocation paths reviewed. BP mapping alone does not prove upper T-CONTs unusable; no artificial T-CONT capacity restriction added.
additional_research.mib_limit: REA decompilation of the stripped libomci_mib MIB_Table_Init remained an explicit tool error. Empty casefold input placeholders were not treated as binaries.
additional_research.identity: Default public PON config has no universal SN or MAC. Per-unit factory import reads GPON_SN and first EPON_LLID_TBL macAddr, with nonempty user UCI options taking precedence. Native XG serial is written to PLOAM registers4a10/4a14; onu_mac supplies Ethernet interface addresses, not the XG PLOAM identity.

limits: No XGPON OLT capture or optical test; hardware event timing and physical resynchronization are not established by the register model.
This defect is proven in initialization and offline recovery behavior; it does not prove the reported -110 business timeout or approximately50-second ACTP3-to0 restart shares this cause.
Only affected ARM64 object compiled; no full firmware build, full test suite, deployment, commit or push.
Goal remains active: whole-path XGPON registration and business correctness remain unproven.
